name: @pipeworx/mcp-maryland-code

tools.name: md_code_section
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Maryland Code — Maryland state statutes — by citation. "Md. Code, Criminal Law 2-201" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Maryland Criminal Law 2-201 say" or to check a Maryland statute a case relies on.

article.description: Maryland article name, e.g. "Criminal Law", "Transportation", "Family Law". Call md_articles for the list.

tools.name: md_articles
tools.description: List the Maryland Code articles this pack can reach. Keyless. Use before md_code_section when you know the subject but not the article name.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-maryland-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the maryland-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
